changelog: - **A timetable can say what a supply can give.** When a table is made, its rates are either a plan or what is available. A supply read as available can move less, as during a planned outage, without a shortfall warning, and its Timeline strip, the connection's details and the run CSV show what was available beside what moved. Help ▸ How a timetable is read explains both. A document with such a table is saved as `loop-studio/graph/7`, so an older version refuses it instead of reading it as a plan.
